performance_issues.description: appendAuthorizedKeysToFile performs filesystem I/O synchronously during the request, writing to the authorized_keys file
performance_issues.impact: File I/O can block under high concurrency; authorized_keys file grows linearly with keys
performance_issues.recommendation: Acceptable for typical usage patterns. Builtin SSH server skips this entirely.

performance_issues.description: RewriteAllPublicKeys rewrites the entire authorized_keys file from all keys in DB after every single key deletion
performance_issues.impact: Full table scan of public_key + full file rewrite. With many keys, this is O(n) per delete. Acquires global SSH op lock.
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider incremental authorized_keys updates instead of full rewrite. Builtin SSH server avoids this.

optimization_recommendations.description: Queue authorized_keys rewrite as async task instead of blocking the API response
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduces DELETE latency from O(n) file rewrite to O(1) DB delete
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use existing queue infrastructure to defer RewriteAllPublicKeys
